controller: Each experiment uses a fresh standard reset, byte-verified recorded ordinary-controller prefix, Left+B braking, then neutral through a genuine collision/fall/timeout, life intro and first return geometry.16 further neutral decisions verify the returned actor. No hidden state, teleport, death API or policy recovery.

declaredTolerances.registration: All observed segments tested; equal best static aliases remain unresolved. Dynamic enemy/animation residuals are retained.
